name: ENVIRONMENT (browser, network or a service did not answer)
LOCATOR_DRIFT (an element the test relies on is not on the page)
messageRegex: (?s)(no such element.*|Expected condition failed: waiting \d+ s for (visibility|clickability|absence) of (all )?By\..*)

name: TIMING (a condition never became true in time)
messageRegex: (?s)Expected condition failed: waiting \d+ s for (?!(visibility|clickability|absence) of (all )?By\.).*

name: TEST_DATA (seeding or cleanup failed)
traceRegex: (?s).*(ApiException|Seeded items were not deleted|still signs in after deletion).*

name: PRODUCT_BUG (the page did not do what the requirement says)
